reason: Conversation 2 asked for the display status and button response up front, then immediately offered child lock as the leading explanation with the 'hold Stop for 3 seconds' fix, resolving the issue in two exchanges with no unsupported claims. Conversation 1 reached the same answer but detoured through a speculative door-latch theory, told the homeowner to unplug the unit before checking door hooks and, oddly, to unplug it before holding the Stop button to clear the lock (which cannot work with the unit unpowered), and never asked what the display showed - the customer volunteered the 'L' symbol. Both were safe and ultimately correct with no part or escalation, but 2 was more efficient, more accurate, and asked the right diagnostic question first.
